text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, July 22 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 1-2 days, bulk vessels 8-10 days, general cargo 3-4 days. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 22 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 12 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Calcutta - 32 Vessels due of which 3 coke coal, 10 product tankers, 7 containers, 2 crude, 2 tneb coal, 1 steel pipes, 1 rock phosphate, 3 logs, 1 lash barge, 2 general cargo. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 18 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 14 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 bunkering. Cochin - 15 Vessels due, up to 1 days delay expected. 4 Vessels discharging at berth, 1 general cargo at CSL jetty, 1 tanker at repair dock and 1 tug for repairs at berth.

Chennai (Madras) - 39 Vessels due of which 8 coal, 3 general, 2 fertiliser, 5 iron ore, 1 barytes, 8 containers, 3 palm oil, 2 sunflower oil, 2 quartz, 1 manganese ore, 1 lube oil, 2 coke, 1 passenger vessel. Delays, coal/coke/others/iron ore 2-3 days, fertiliser, scrap 5-6 days, no delays for containers. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 9 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Mormugao - One vessel due, up to 1 days delay expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchage to load, 3 under repair. Kandla - 13 Vessels due, 10-15 days berthing delay expected. 3 vessels loading at berth, 10 waiting to load, 3 loading in stream, 4 discharging at berth, 3 tankers. 22 Vessels waiting, 11 waiting to discharge.

Mangalore - 10 Vessels due, 2-3 days delay expected. 8 Vessels loading/discharging at berth, 7 awaiting berth. Jawaharlal Nehru - Three tankers/iron ore vessels due. Berthing delays expected, urea 20-25 days, other fertiliser 25 days, tankers/iron ore vessels 2-3 days. 2 Vessels discharging at berth, 6 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Paradip - 11 Vessels due, 11 days delay expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Tuticorin - Three vessels due, 1-2 days delay. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 under repair/drydock.

Visakhapatnam - 19 Vessels due, 7-8 days delay expected. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 14 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 8 waiting at anchorage to load at inner harbour berth.

MALAYSIA, July 23 - Port Keelang - North/south port container/ro-ro berth - 9 Vessels alongside, 8 waiting. No waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 6 Vessels alongside, 5 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Dry/bulk cement terminal - 3 Vessels alongside. 4 waiting, 4 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 3 Vessels alongside, 4 waiting, 2 days waiting time. West port container/ro-ro berth - 3 Vessels alongside, 1 waiting, no waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels alongside, 6 waiting, 3 days waiting time. Dry/bulk cement terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, 1 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 1 Vessel alongside, no waiting time.

PAKISTAN, July 21 - Karachi - Five vessels due. Delays up to 1 day for general cargo, 2 days for tankers. 6 Vessels loading at berth (rice, general cargo, molasses). 4 Containers loading and discharging at berth, 3 general cargo discharging at berth, 1 awaiting orders, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Port Qasim - Six vessels discharging at berth (wheat, coils, fuel oil, sugar, 5 waiting at anchorage to discharge sugar.

SOUTH KOREA, July 22 - Inchon - 76 Vessels in port (46 berthed, 30 anchored) of which 8 logs, 7 general cargo, 4 corn, 3 each pulp, wheat, containers, 2 each cars, pig iron, copra, tapioca, grain, ply, 1 each wire rods, raw sugar, glass, coil, salt, scrap. Anchored, 5 containers, 3 each corn, scrap, 2 each soybean, pig iron, cars, ply, general cargo, coils, 1 each logs, palm oil, wheat blending pellets, steel, soda, copra, soybean meal. Approx. 1-2 days delay expected.

Busan - 154 Vessels in port (43 berthed, 111 anchored including 56 laid up) of which 28 general cargo, 8 container vessels, 4 scrap, 3 coal. 55 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 1 days delay expected. Pohang - 26 Vessels in port (22 berthed, 4 anchored) of which discharging, 4 steel scrap, 3 iron ore, 2 each steel products, clinker. 11 Vessels loading steel products. Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 1-2 days delay expected.

Ulsan - 26 Vessels in port (25 berthed, 1 anchored) of which discharging, 2 each corn, mono ethyl glycol, 1 each coal, flourspar, cokes, logs, salt, soda ash, paraxylene, fertiliser, caustic soda, zinc concentrates, copper concentrate, woodchips. Loading, 2 each general cargo, steel pipes, 1 each steel products, fertiliser, pta, chemicals, diesel oil. 1 Vessel awaiting berth with approx. 2 days delay expected. Masa - Four vessels berthed of which discharging, 1 scrap, 1 silica sand, 1 steel coils, 1 vessel loading steel structure. No berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, July 22 - Colombo - Vessels due, 10 container/feeders, 1 ro-ro, 1 bulk palm oil. Delays, general cargo 3-5 days, container/feeders 2-3 days. 16 Vessels loading at berth of which 4 essential services, 12 containers. Discharging at berth, 1 bagged sugar, 16 containers, 1 bagged cement, 1 bagged mop, 2 general cargo, 1 bagged fertiliser, 1 essential services, 1 bulk palm oil, 1 onions/steel. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load pallets of tea. Waiting at anchorage to discharge, 9 container/feeders dischargers/loaders, 1 lpg, 1 bagged flour, 2 bagged urea, 1 general cargo, 1 bagged cement. 3 Bunkering, 1 under repairs, 1 in drydocks, 9 arrest orders, 5 awaiting orders from principals, 1 crew change, 1 vessel at SPBM. Labour shortage continues. Delays in berthing/unberthing (pilotage) on breakbulk conventional vessels. Galle - No vessels discharging/loading. Trincomalee - Two vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth.

TAIWAN, July 21 - Keelung - Three vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain, coal 4 days, steel iron ore 3 days. Kaohsiung - Six vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 3 days, iron/coal 5 days (SCS berth), coal/scrap 6 days (public berth), steel 2 days. Taichung - - Seven vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 15 days, iron ore, coal, scrap, steel 1 day, others 1-2 days. July 22 - Keelung - Vessels in port, 12 containers, 1 tanker, 6 other bulkers, 5 general, 2 container vessels waiting at outer anchorage with 8 hours berthing delay. Kaohsiung - Two days delay in port. Vessels loading at berth, 56 vessels discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 6 bunkering, 1 under repair/drydock.
THAILAND, July 22 - Bangkok - 79 Vessels in port of which 5 containers, 1 tanker, 73 other bulkers and general cargo vessels. 4 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage. No berthing delay expected.
